_why: P5-005 requires recorded wire fixtures. This is NOT a recorded provider response: no connector exists yet and no request has been sent. It is a hand-built payload that reproduces the documented response shape exactly, so that changes to the documented shape are visible as a fixture change. A real capture replaces this file.
_sanitized: All identifiers are placeholders. Addresses use the reserved `.invalid` TLD, which can never resolve, so a fixture can never point at a real mailbox.
